notes: robots.txt checked: no Claude-specific disallow (anthropic-ai and ClaudeBot both have explicit Allow: /). Discovery via HTTP fetch of homepage HTML/mega-menu (Furniture, Outdoor, Decor, Lights, Furnishings, Kitchen, DIY & Tools, Bath, Laundry & Organizers, Electronics & Appliances, School, Tiles & Flooring, Sale), the site footer's full 'Popular Categories' list, and a keyword grep (christmas, xmas, diwali, deepavali, eid, ramadan, halloween, easter, valentine, new-year, festive, festival, holiday, seasonal, national-day, thanksgiving) over the full category sitemap (category_sitemap_ae_en.xml, 1539 URLs). Only one genuine seasonal product-listing category exists in the real taxonomy: 'Festive Decorations' under Decor (mega-menu item, breadcrumb Home Decor > Festive Decorations), a single mixed-holiday PLP verified live in-browser with 45 products spanning Christmas trees/ornaments and Ramadan/Eid decor (prayer beads, mosque displays, Ramadan lanterns) under one taxonomy node -- captured as category Festive. Excluded as marketing/sale, not genuine categories (verified live): /c/eid-shopping (breadcrumb has no category_name; a generic 98-result dumping ground built from Home Furnishing/Dining/Decor/Kitchen/Lights links, blank internal search query, no Eid-specific products); /c/eid-super-sale-gifting (11 generic sale-priced gift items -- wall clocks, cookware, candle holders -- promotional Sale bucket, no Eid theme); plus ~15 sitemap hits that are pure sale/deal campaign pages (bogo-ramadan, ramadan-clearance-sale, ramadan-top-picks, chandeliers-ramadan-exclusive, super-deals-pre-ramadan, mp-ramadan-deals-*, new-year-25-additional-10, sofa-festival, yes-25-milano-festival-*, yes-25-cook-and-save-festival-*, ae/bh/om-full-back-festival-excluded) -- 'festival' here is internal sale-event branding, not a cultural holiday, and all are Sale/Offers pages per the shared exclusion rule. Also excluded: /c/artificial-christmas-tree, a real category node (breadcrumb-confirmed, category_level 2) but verified live at 0 products ('0 Results for Artificial Christmas Tree') -- dropped per the 0-product convention rather than written as a zero row. No Diwali, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, or Thanksgiving categories found anywhere in nav, footer, or sitemap keyword search -- consistent with a UAE-market site whose seasonal taxonomy centers on Christmas and Ramadan/Eid. Arabic storefront (/ae/ar) shares the same sitemap/category structure (hreflang alternates checked) and was not separately crawled; the English category sitemap already surfaces the Ramadan/Eid campaign slugs in Latin script, so no additional local-language-only seasonal branch is expected.
